title: Fix two bugs in a small shopping-cart package
prompt:
The `shop` package in this directory has two bugs.
1. After removing every unit of an item from a Cart (Cart.remove), `cart.line_count()` still counts that item as a line.
2. Discounted totals are wrong: `Cart.total_cents(code)` with a percentage code (for example SAVE10) truncates the fractional cent instead of rounding half up. For example a total of 5995 cents with SAVE10 must give 5396 (5395.5 rounded half up), not 5395.
Find and fix the bugs in the package code (not in the tests), and make sure `python -m pytest -q tests` still passes.
